svg.text: Each row changes one thing from the first sheet’s Blob. The small pair is 32 and 16 points.
The same Blob on six colours. Violet is the one from the first sheet.
Expression carries the character. The first is today's.
The outline: softer, rounder, a ghost, peeking up, a drop, or with a friend.
Violet and orange beside stand-ins for other agent apps.
Orange sits too close to Claude’s own colour.
